verdict.rationale: The docs describe a "living knowledge graph of facts on top of other facts" and user profiles that are "automatically maintained" and "update as users interact." The comparison page names "no temporal truth" (both "loved Adidas" and "switched to Puma" staying equally relevant) as a weakness that Supermemory implies it solves, and customId re-ingestion processes only new content. However, no evidence explicitly documents how contradictory facts are superseded, versioned, or merged. Missing for 10: explicit docs on contradiction detection and supersede/merge semantics, examples showing old facts being invalidated or ranked lower, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
